summary: Beam Global filed an 8-K announcing an October 6, 2026 Share Sale and Purchase Agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of ScoutDI AS, a Norwegian industrial-inspection drone and analytics provider, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. Base purchase price is $24 million, payable 10% in Beam common stock valued at the five-day VWAP pre-signing and 90% cash, with 15% escrowed 18 months. Sellers may elect shares in lieu of cash, capped by Nasdaq Rule 5635. Earn-outs target $2.4 million for 2026 and revenue-based 2027 payments. Watch integration, revenue thresholds, and share-cap cash overhang.
